name: rosetta-rep-string
code:
use default

repeats(text: string, size: int) -> bool =>
    (0..text.length) |> all(index => text[index] == text[index % size])

for text in ["1001110011", "1110111011", "0010010010", "1010101010",
             "1111111111", "0100101101", "0100100", "101", "11",
             "00", "1"] do
    if let size = (1::text.length / 2)
        |> reverse()
        |> find(candidate => repeats(text, candidate))
    then
        write_line("{text} repeats {text[0..size]}")
    else
        write_line("{text} is not a rep-string")
    fi
